title: Lived-In Room
idea: Furniture that already belongs to a life.
brand_story: Lea built WohnRaum Partner because they are specific — not interchangeable. Clients (30–50) should feel trust and desire to stay. Only then do we name the craft: realestate.
core_promise: Furniture that already belongs to a life.
visual_metaphor: an empty chair that still feels occupied
scene_language: real rooms, soft daylight, human traces
color_emotion: oak, linen, soft clay, muted green
interaction_style: browse like walking through a home
photo_world: morning living room, book on table, plant
agency_note: Think like a creative agency director on a €50,000 brief. No idea → no HTML. Creative Identity becomes site, store, social, video, ads.
question: Who is the human — and what idea can you feel?
not_question: How do we assemble a psychologist website?
